updates.content:
Title: Users may experience delays receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 60 minutes.

Title: Users may experience delays receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts users who may be attempting to receive email messages from external domains in Exchange Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 12:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may experience delays sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may experience a delay in sending and receiving email messages from external domains in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may experience intermittent “Server busy” errors, affecting multiple mailboxes.

Current status: Our initial investigation has identified instances where anti-spam protections may be contributing to impact for a subset of users. We are continuing to analyse the behaviour and review service telemetry to better understand the underlying cause and determine the most effective mitigation path.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts users who may be attempting to send and receive email messages from external domains in Exchange Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, September 4, 2026, at 12:30 PM UTC
